rules.name: Internal Rivalries
rules.effect:
^^**Emperor's Children Character**^^ units from your army can ignore any or all modifiers to their Move characteristic and any or all modifiers to Advance and Charge rolls made for them.

At the start of the battle, your **^^Warlord^^**'s unit is your army's Favoured Champions. The first time in each player's turn that an **^^Emperor's Children Character**^^ unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, after resolving all of its attacks, that **^^Character**^^ unit becomes your army's Favoured Champions, replacing the old one.

Each time a model in your army's Favoured Champions unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Devoted Duellists
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One or more EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in those CHARACTER units have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting that enemy unit.
stratagems.summary: Grant [SUSTAINED HITS 1] to friendly CHARACTER melee weapons against selected enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Beautiful Death
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is your army’s Favoured Champions. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.summary: Destroyed models (not yet fought) roll D6 (+1 if Favoured Champions); 4+ fight before removal.

stratagems.name: Heightened Jealousy
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions, or just after your army’s Favoured Champions unit destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.cond: Your army’s Favoured Champions unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that is not your army’s Favoured Champions makes an attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.summary: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER (non-Favoured Champions): +1 Strength to attacks.

stratagems.name: Diabolic Majesty
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions.
stratagems.cond: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
stratagems.summary: Enemy units within 6" take Battle-shock tests with -1 to result.

stratagems.name: Refusal to Be Outdone
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit within 12" of an engaged enemy unit declares a charge.
stratagems.cond: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can re-roll charge rolls. Your unit must end that charge move engaged with one or more of those enemy units.
stratagems.summary: Unit can re-roll charge rolls; must end engaged with target enemy units.

stratagems.name: Vengeful Surge
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is not your army’s Favoured Champions, you can re-roll the dice to determine the distance of that surge move.
stratagems.summary: Surge move up to D6"; re-roll if not Favoured Champions.

enhancements.name: Eager to Prove
enhancements.effect: You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit. While the bearer's unit is your army's Favoured Champions, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Repulsed by Weakness
enhancements.effect: Each time an enemy unit (excluding **^^Monster**^^ and ^^**Vehicle**^^ units) within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit Falls Back, models in that enemy unit must take Desperate Escape tests. When doing so, if the bearer's unit is your army's Favoured Champions, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.

enhancements.name: Proud and Vainglorious
enhancements.effect: You can re-roll Battle-shock and Leadership tests taken for the bearer's unit. While the bearer's unit is your army's Favoured Champions, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Slayer of Champions
enhancements.effect: The bearer's melee weapons have the [^^Precision^^] ability, and each time the bearer makes a melee attack that targets a ^^**Character**^^ unit, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.

rules.name: Exquisite Swordsmanship
rules.effect:
Each time an ^^**Emperor's Children**^^ unit from your army is selected to fight, if it made a Charge move this turn, select one of the abilities below. While resolving those attacks, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the ability:
- [^^Lethal Hits^^]
- [^^Sustained Hits 1^^]

stratagems.name: Deft Parry
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.summary: -1 to Hit rolls on all incoming attacks.

stratagems.name: Death Ecstasy
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.summary: Destroyed models that haven't fought this phase can still fight, then removed.

stratagems.name: Incessant Violence
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just before an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army Consolidates.
stratagems.cond: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", provided your unit ends that Consolidation move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.summary: Consolidation moves up to 6" instead of 3" if ending in Engagement Range of enemies.

stratagems.name: Cruel Bladesman
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
stratagems.summary: +1 AP to melee weapons.

stratagems.name: Terrifying Spectacle
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that made a Charge move in the previous turn and destroyed one or more enemy units in the previous Fight phase.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if they are Below Half-strength. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
stratagems.summary: Each enemy unit within 6" takes Battle-shock test (-1 if Below Half-strength); blocks other Battle-shock tests this phase.

stratagems.name: Cut Down the Weak
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army (you can only select a VEHICLE if it is a WALKER) that is within 6" of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can declare a charge. When doing so, you must select that enemy unit as a target of that charge, and your unit does not receive a Charge bonus this turn.
stratagems.summary: Unit charges selected enemy; no Charge bonus this turn.

enhancements.name: Faultless Opportunist
enhancements.effect:
You can target this unit with the **Heroic Intervention stratagem**, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do: 
- That use is -1 CP. 
- That use does not prevent any uses of that **stratagem** on other units this phase.

enhancements.name: Blinding Speed
enhancements.effect: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does so, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Distortion
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks and Damage characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Rise to the Challenge
enhancements.effect: Once per battle, at the end of the Fight phase, if the bearer is within Engagement Range of three or more enemy models, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer can fight one additional time. When doing so, you can select one ability using the Exquisite Swordsmanship Detachment rule to apply to those attacks.

rules.name: Mechanised Murder
rules.effect: Each time an ^^**Emperor's Children^^** model from your army makes an attack, if it is a ^^**Transport^^** model or disembarked from a ^^**Transport^^** this turn, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Onto the Next
stratagems.timing: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that destroyed an enemy unit this phase, and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.
stratagems.effect: If your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it. Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT in a turn it disembarked from a TRANSPORT.
stratagems.summary: Embark if wholly within 6", even if disembarked this turn.

stratagems.name: Advance and Claim
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army that has one or more TORMENTORS units embarked within it (excluding Battle-shocked units).
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your TRANSPORT is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.summary: TRANSPORT controls objective while its Level of Control exceeds opponent's.

stratagems.name: Dynamic Breakthrough
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.
stratagems.summary: Models move through enemy INFANTRY/BIKERS; can enter but not end in Engagement Range; auto-pass Desperate Escape tests.

stratagems.name: Ceaseless Onslaught
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT that made a Normal move this turn.
stratagems.effect: Your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit is treated as having made an assault disembark move (Core Rules, 18.06) for that disembarkation.
stratagems.summary: Unit counts as making an assault disembark move.

stratagems.name: Reactive Disembarkation
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit embarked within your TRANSPORT can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.summary: One embarked EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit disembarks anywhere within 6" of TRANSPORT, not in Engagement Range of enemies.

stratagems.name: Outflanking Strike
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army, or up to two EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DEDICATED TRANSPORTS from your army.
stratagems.effect: For each of those TRANSPORTS wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.summary: Remove TRANSPORTS within 9" of battlefield edges; place into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Sublime Presence
enhancements.effect: Once per turn, in your Movement phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one friendly **^^Emperor's Children Transport**^^ that is in Strategic Reserves. Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up that **^^Transport**^^ on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

enhancements.name: Spearhead Striker
enhancements.effect: Each time the bearer disembarks from a **^^Transport**^^, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit and enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Accomplished Tactician
enhancements.effect: Once per turn, in your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, you can select one friendly **^^Emperor's Children**^^ unit within 9" of the bearer that was hit by one or more of those attacks, then select one friendly **^^Transport**^^ that unit is wholly within 6" of and is able to embark within. That **^^Emperor's Children**^^ unit can embark in that **^^Transport**^^.

enhancements.name: Heretek Adept
enhancements.effect: Once per battle round, when a saving throw is failed for a friendly **^^Emperor's Children Vehicle**^^ model within 6" of the bearer, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

rules.name: Pledges to the Dark Prince
rules.effect:
At the start of the battle round, if your **^^Warlord^^** is on the battlefield, you must pledge a number to Slaanesh representing how many enemy units will be destroyed this battle round. At the end of the battle round, if the number of enemy units destroyed this battle round is greater than or equal to your pledge, you gain a number of Pact points equal to your pledge. Otherwise, you do not gain any Pact points this battle round and your **^^Warlord**^^ model suffers D3 mortal wounds.

**^^Emperor's Children^^** units from your army gain a bonus depending on how many Pact points you have gained during the battle, as shown below (these are all cumulative).

1+: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
3+: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
5+: Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [^^Lethal Hits^^] and [^^Sustained Hits 1^^]] abilities.
7+: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

stratagems.name: Protection of the Dark Prince
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after a mortal wound or attack is allocated to a model in an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.
stratagems.cond: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
stratagems.summary: FNP 6+ vs all damage; FNP 4+ vs mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Unshakeable Opponents
stratagems.timing: Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack’s Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll; the Wound roll.
stratagems.summary: Ignore modifiers to BS/WS, Hit rolls, or Wound rolls until end of turn.

stratagems.name: Embrace the Pain
stratagems.timing: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets, it must select your unit as the target of its attacks.
stratagems.summary: Enemy models within Engagement Range must target your unit.

stratagems.name: Martial Perfection
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll Hit rolls for unit's attacks until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Unbound Arrogance
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.cond: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.
stratagems.effect: Increase your pledge to Slaanesh by 1.
stratagems.summary: Increase Slaanesh pledge by 1.

stratagems.name: Armour of Abhorrence
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.summary: -1 AP on all incoming attacks.

stratagems.name: Unbound Arrogance
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.cond: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.
stratagems.effect: Increase your pledge to Slaanesh by 1.
stratagems.summary: Increase Slaanesh pledge by 1.

enhancements.name: Pledge of Eternal Servitude
enhancements.effect: The first time the bearer is destroyed, take a Leadership test for the bearer at the end of the phase. if that test is passed, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with D6 wounds remaining (up to its Wounds characteristic).

enhancements.name: Pledge of Dark Glory
enhancements.effect: While the bearer is leading a unit, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1.

enhancements.name: Pledge of Mortal Pain
enhancements.effect: At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 2 from the result if it is Battle-shocked: if failed, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Pledge of Unholy Fortune
enhancements.effect: Once per turn, after making a Hit roll, a Wound roll or a saving throw for a model in the bearer's unit, if the bearer is not Battle-shocked, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, treat the result as an unmodified roll of 6 instead.

rules.name: Quicksilver Grace
rules.effect: You can re-roll Advance rolls made for **^^Emperor's Children^^** units from your army.

stratagems.name: Violent Excess
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant [SUSTAINED HITS 1] to unit's melee weapons.

stratagems.name: Combat Stimms
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.summary: -1 to Wound rolls on incoming attacks.

stratagems.name: Honour the Prince
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
stratagems.summary: Unit that Advances gains +6" to Move instead of rolling.

stratagems.name: Dark Vigour
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army (excluding BEASTS and VEHICLES) that is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.summary: Unit makes Normal move up to 6".

stratagems.name: Capricious Reactions
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.summary: -1 to Hit rolls on all incoming attacks.

stratagems.name: Cruel Raiders
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within 3" horizontally of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.summary: Remove unit from battlefield; place into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Steeped in Suffering
enhancements.effect: Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If that target is also Below Half-Strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

enhancements.name: Intoxicating Musk
enhancements.effect: Each time a melee attack targets the bearer's unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Tactical Perfection
enhancements.effect: After both players have deployed their armies, select up to two **^^Emperor's Children**^^ units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Loathsome Dexterity
enhancements.effect: Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through enemy models. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

rules.name: Daemonic Empowerment
rules.effect:
- While an ^^**Emperor's Children^^** unit from your army is within 6" of one or more friendly ^^**Legions of Excess**^^ units, it is Empowered.
- While a ^^**Legions of Excess**^^ unit from your army is within 6" of one or more friendly  ^^**Emperor's Children^^** units, it is Empowered.

While a unit from your army is Empowered, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [^^Sustained Hits 1^^] ability. If such a weapon already has that ability, each time an attack is made with that weapon, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Sustained by Agony
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.cond: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit within 6" of your unit. One model in that LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit recovers up to 3 lost wounds or, if it is a DAEMONETTES unit, return upto D3+3 destroyed models to it instead.
stratagems.summary: Recover up to 3 wounds on nearby LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit, or return up to D3+3 destroyed DAEMONETTES instead.

stratagems.name: Ecstatic Slaughter
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after a LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.cond: That LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit and one friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit within 6" of it that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit can declare a charge. If it does so and it has already been selected to fight this phase, it cannot fight again this phase.
stratagems.summary: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit can declare a charge after already fighting this phase; cannot fight again.

stratagems.name: Violent Crescendo
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One SLAANESH BEASTS, SLAANESH INFANTRY or SLAANESH MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". When doing so, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.
stratagems.summary: Pile-in/Consolidation moves up to 6" instead of 3"; ignore closest-model requirement if ending closest to enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Sycophantic Surge
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.cond: One LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, provided at least one of the targets of that charge is within Engagement Range of one or more EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units from your army.
stratagems.summary: Charge after Advancing/Falling Back if target in Engagement Range of your EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit.

stratagems.name: Uncanny Reactions
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One SLAANESH unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.summary: -1 to Hit rolls on all incoming attacks.

stratagems.name: Dark Apparitions
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One DAEMONETTES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. If it arrives back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units (instead of more than 8"), provided it is also set up wholly within 8" of one or more friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units.
stratagems.summary: Remove unit to Strategic Reserves; return via Deep Strike within 6" of enemy units (instead of 8") if set up within 8" of friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit.

enhancements.name: Empyric Suffusion
enhancements.effect: When you target this unit with the **Heroic Intervention stratagem**, that use is -1 CP.

enhancements.name: Dark Blessings

***Example:** An attack made with a **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** weapon results in a **critical hit**. That attack therefore hits the target three times (once from the **critical hit**, and twice more from the **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** ability).*

glossary.effect:
Each time a unit containing one or more models with an **[EXTRA ATTACKS]** weapon fights, those models will make attacks with those weapons in addition to any others. In the Select Weapons step (04.01), for each of those models, you must select: 
- All of that model’s **[EXTRA ATTACKS]** weapons. 
- One of that model’s other melee weapons, if possible.

glossary.name: Infiltrators
glossary.effect: During deployment, if every model in a unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from your opponent’s deployment zone and all enemy units.

glossary.name: Scouts
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **Scouts X"**. In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, if every model in a unit has this ability, you can do one of the following: 
- If that unit is in **strategic reserves**, you can set up that unit anywhere that is wholly within your deployment zone.

glossary.name: Pistol
glossary.effect:
**[PISTOL]** and **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]** are identical for all rules purposes. 

Units containing one or more models with a **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]** weapon can shoot using **close-quarters shooting** (10.06). When using another **shooting type**, for each model in that unit (excluding **MONSTER/VEHICLE** models), you can only select one of the following to make attacks with: 
- One or more of its **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]** weapons. 
- One or more of its other ranged weapons.

glossary.name: Hazardous
glossary.effect: Each time a unit is **selected to shoot** or **selected to fight**, after that unit has resolved all of its attacks, make a number of **hazard rolls** (06.03) for that unit equal to the number of **[HAZARDOUS]** weapons you selected in the Select Weapons step.

glossary.name: Ignores Cover
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with an **[IGNORES COVER]** weapon, the target cannot have the **benefit of cover** against that attack (13.08), including from rules that give a model or unit the **benefit of cover** (e.g. **Stealth**).

glossary.name: Lance
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with a **[LANCE]** weapon, if the attacking model’s unit made a **charge move** this turn, add 1 to the **wound roll**.

glossary.name: Psychic
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with a **[PSYCHIC]** weapon, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s **BS** or **WS** characteristic and any or all modifiers to the **hit roll**. Attacks made with **[PSYCHIC]** weapons are known as **psychic attacks** (this can be important for the triggering of other rules).

glossary.name: Devastating Wounds
glossary.effect:
Each time an attack made with a **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** weapon results in a **critical wound**, the attack sequence for that attack ends and the target unit suffers a number of **mortal wounds** equal to the **D** characteristic of that weapon. These are inflicted after resolving any normal damage inflicted by those attacks. 
**Mortal wounds** inflicted by **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** weapons can damage a maximum of one model for each **critical wound**; any remaining **mortal wounds** inflicted by that attack are lost. 
***Example:** An attack made with a **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** weapon with a **D** characteristic of 3 results in a **critical wound** against an Intercessor Squad, so inflicts 3 **mortal wounds**. The first 2 **mortal wounds** are sufficient to **destroy** 1 Intercessor model, so the remaining **mortal wound** is lost.*

glossary.name: Rapid Fire
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[RAPID FIRE X]**. Each time you gather **attack dice** for a **[RAPID FIRE]** weapon, add **X** additional **attack dice** if the target unit was within half range of that weapon in the Select Targets step. 
***Example:** If a **[RAPID FIRE 1]** weapon with an **A** characteristic of 1 targets a unit that is within half range, you would gather one additional **attack dice** for that weapon (for a total of two for that weapon).*

glossary.name: Melta
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[MELTA X]**. Each time a model makes an attack with a **[MELTA]** weapon, if the target unit was within half range of that weapon in the Select Targets step, until the attacking unit’s attacks have been resolved, add **X** to that weapon’s **D** characteristic. 
***Example:** A model targets a unit that is within half range of a **[MELTA 2]** weapon with a **D** characteristic of D6. While resolving those attacks, that weapon has a **D** characteristic of **D6+2**.*

glossary.name: Twin-linked
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with a **[TWIN-LINKED]** weapon, you can re-roll the **wound roll**.

glossary.name: Anti
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[ANTI-X Y+]**. Each time an attack is made with an **[ANTI]** weapon, if the target unit has the keyword denoted by **X**, an unmodified **wound roll** of **Y+** is a **critical wound**.
***Example:** An attack made with an **[ANTI-VEHICLE 4+]** weapon against a ^^**Vehicle**^^ unit will result in a **critical wound** on an unmodified **wound roll** of 4+, while an attack made with an **[ANTI-PSYKER 2+]** weapon against a ^^**Psyker**^^ unit will result in a **critical wound** on an unmodified **wound roll** of 2+.*

glossary.name: Torrent
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with a **[TORRENT]** weapon, that attack automatically hits the target.

glossary.name: Blast
glossary.effect:
Each time you gather attack dice for a **[BLAST]** weapon, add one additional **attack dice** for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down). If this ability takes the form **[BLAST X]**, each time you gather **attack dice** for such a weapon, add **X** additional **attack dice** for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down) instead. 
***Example:** If a **[BLAST 2]** weapon with an **A** characteristic of 3 targets a unit containing 12 models, you would gather four additional **attack dice** for that weapon (for a total of seven for that weapon).*

glossary.name: Hover
glossary.effect: Each time this unit **takes to the skies** (21.03), do not subtract 2" from the **maximum distance**.

glossary.name: Firing Deck
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **Firing Deck X**. In your Shooting phase, each time this **TRANSPORT** is **selected to shoot**, if one or more units are embarked within it, resolve the following sequence: 
1. Select up to **X** models embarked within this **TRANSPORT** (excluding models whose units have already been **selected to shoot** this phase). 
2. For each selected model, select one of its ranged weapons (excluding **[ONE SHOT]** weapons). 
3. Until this **TRANSPORT** has resolved all of its attacks, it has all of those selected weapons in addition to its other weapons. 
4. Until the end of the turn, units embarked within this **TRANSPORT** are not eligible to shoot.

glossary.name: Assault
glossary.effect: Units containing one or more models with an **[ASSAULT]** weapon can shoot using **assault shooting** (10.05).

glossary.name: Fights First
glossary.effect:
While every model in a unit has this ability, that unit is a **Fights First** unit. 
See the Resolve Fights First Combats step in the Fight phase (12.04).

***Designer’s Note:** Choosing to automatically wound the target means that no **wound roll** is made for that attack. You may decide against this, as it means that attack cannot result in a **critical wound** and so cannot trigger other abilities such as [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].*
